portal_hypertension.title: ERAS (enhanced recovery after surgery) protocol improves recovery in surgical management of pediatric non-cirrhotic portal hypertension: evaluating results of pre and post-ERAS implementation.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hasan S, Çeltik Ü, Ergün O
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：需要复杂门体分流手术的儿童非肝硬化门静脉高压症 (PHT) 的标准化围手术期途径仍然缺乏。 临床提示：加速康复外科 (ERAS) 方案旨在减少手术压力并优化术后恢复。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Standardized perioperative pathways for pediatric non-cirrhotic portal hypertension (PHT) requiring complex portosystemic shunt surgery remain scarce. Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols aim to reduce surgical stress and optimize postoperative recovery. This study evaluates the impact of ERAS implementation on outcomes in children undergoing shunt procedures for PHT. A retrospective cohort study was conducted over 18 years. Patients were divided into two groups: Group I (pre-ERAS,2006-2016) and Group II (post-ERAS,2016-2024). portal_hypertension.title: Numerical study on the impacts of shunt pathway presence, anatomical characteristics, and occlusion degree in patients with spontaneous splenorenal shunt.
portal_hypertension.journal: Computer methods in biomechanics and biomedical engineering
portal_hypertension.authors: Cao X, Liu F, Zhao P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：自发性脾肾分流术（SSRS）很复杂，并且与肝性脑病发病率增加相关。 临床提示：SSRS 治疗不当可能会导致门脉高压 (PH) 恶化。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Spontaneous splenorenal shunts (SSRSs) are complex and associated with increased hepatic encephalopathy incidence. Improper treatments of SSRSs may cause portal hypertension (PH) deterioration. This study aims to evaluate the effects of the presence and various characteristics of SSRS on portal venous system hemodynamics and to explore the impacts of SSRS occlusion by investigating dynamic changes of portal venous pressure (PVP) before and after occlusion. Numerical simulations are performed through patient-specific models constructed from computed tomography angiography images and boundary conditions obtained from ultrasound velocity and balloon manometry measurements.
